field_text_formatted.value: Which filters run is a second tick, on filter_format--filter_format. It tells a frontend whether a caption arrives in a data-caption attribute or in the markup. Fetch it once first: JSON:API hands over whole entities, so that is every format on the site and each one's filter settings, an open blob contrib modules fill with their own keys.
